brief: multi-step onboarding wizard for accounting software

defects.what: Current step in the progress bar is drawn faintest; segments unlabeled
Programmatic focus puts a heavy ring on the heading at load
At 390px the gap between stacked fields is larger than elsewhere; misstated grouping
Exit, the fiscal-year hint and an inline 'Why' link compete; the 'Why' modal hides text that could be inline
Help '?' button 36px and 'Why' link 32px tall, under the phone minimum
Two overlapping help mechanisms explain the same step
Back, Skip and Next in three styles; optional steps not marked until an error
Muted hint, progress and placeholder text small and low contrast, especially dark
Popover covers the field it explains; no arrow, no close
Popover drawn like the card, so in dark mode it blends in
Muted body copy; no close control; 'Got it' only
Harmless 'exit and save' styled as danger, louder than Keep going
Dialog promises progress is saved, but only the step number is
Dark mode: white text on salmon fill, weak contrast

reviewer: Claude Sonnet, blind review of screenshots and source (never saw the rule list)
